subject: MAP: activation cadence & POC environment handoff
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medlink.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medlink.com>, procurement@medlink.com
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff & environment checklist (MedLink POC)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our team is aligned to move ahead with a two-week POC. Procurement asked me to put together a short mutual action plan so we can lock a final activation window. High-level asks from our infra and security teams:

- API keys issuance and rotation plan
- Organization-level setup (team invites, roles)
- IP allowlist template for our egress NATs
- VPC peering runbook (we're on Azure)

Can you share a simple MAP with owners + target dates? Ideally we aim to go live the week of Oct 12 if Redwood can provision keys and peering by the 9th. Also, please send any network templates we can fill in.

Emily
Emily Zhao
Security & Integrations, MedLink Health
emily.zhao@medlink.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medlink.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medlink.com>, procurement@medlink.com
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & environment checklist (MedLink POC)

Hi Emily — great to hear and excited to move this forward. Attached is a concise MAP spreadsheet and the network templates you asked for. Summary below (owners and dates):

1) Org setup (Redwood): marissa_cole to invite MedLink service accounts and set roles — target Oct 5
2) API keys (Redwood): I will generate scoped API keys for the POC and share rotation notes — target Oct 6 (keys valid for test environment)
3) IP allowlist (MedLink & Redwood): MedLink to populate network-allowlist-template.csv; Redwood to confirm and add to allowlist — target completed Oct 8
4) VPC peering (Joint): Ben Carter will own the peering coordination and provide peering runbook + Azure specifics; target peering established Oct 9
5) Smoke tests & sampling (Joint): Oct 12–13; final close/decision by Oct 16

Attachments included: redwood-map-checklist-v1.xlsx, network-allowlist-template.csv, vpc-peering-runbook.pdf.

If Oct 12–13 is tight for your team, tell us and we can slide the smoke tests to Oct 15–16. Next steps: Emily, can you confirm who will own filling the allowlist and a point-of-contact for your infra team? I'll loop Marissa and Ben for internal tracking.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff & environment checklist (MedLink POC)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Emily's note and my MAP outline. Quick internal plan:

- Marissa: org invites and RBAC config. Please prepare a short step-by-step (5–7 bullets) so MedLink can confirm roles.
- Ben: own the VPC peering thread; include Azure subnet CIDR mapping and expected iptables/nsg rules.
- I'll handle API key generation and deliver secure key share (DocuSign link or secure artifact).

Timing: keys by 10/6, peering by 10/9. If either slips we need to bump smoke test window. Please confirm you can take these actions by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Aditya

Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & environment checklist (MedLink POC)

Aditya — thanks for the clear plan. A couple quick notes from my side after sync with infra: 

- We'll own filling the network-allowlist-template.csv (I'll put Sanjay as the POC) — expect to return by EOD Oct 6.
- Our security team requested a copy of Redwood's SOC2 SOC2-type documentation and a short description of key generation + rotation flow for test keys. Can you attach or point to a link?
- Can we shift the smoke tests to Oct 15–16? That gives our network team a little buffer.

I attach our current network worksheet for the team to reference (medlink-network-sheet.xlsx).

If you can provide the SOC2 artifact and confirm the new smoke test window (Oct 15–16), procurement will complete the minimal PO and we can proceed.

Emily

Attachment: medlink-network-sheet.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medlink.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & environment checklist (MedLink POC)

Hi Emily — jumping in to confirm we've actioned the items on our side.

- Org invites: invited two MedLink service accounts today (roles: viewer + limited-admin for POC). You should see invites from no-reply@redwood.com.
- API keys: Aditya will generate scoped test keys on Oct 6 and we will deliver via secure DocuSign envelope (attachment: docusign-map-ack.pdf) — keys will be time-limited to 30 days.
- VPC peering: Ben has the runbook; he'll reach out to Sanjay directly with the Azure peering steps and expected CIDR mapping.
- SOC2: here's a link to our compliance portal where you can download the SOC2 summary and evidence bundle: https://redwood-compliance.example/soc2/summary (password-protected; I'll send password in a separate email).

I've also created a short MAP acknowledgement DocuSign (link below) so procurement can sign the agreed timeline and standard terms. Once signed, procurement and we will treat the Oct 15–16 smoke tests as confirmed.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/receipts/abc123-map-ack

Let me know if anything else — Ben, pls confirm when you start the peering ticket.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
